name: butterfly 🦋 life
desc:
It is time for your butterfly life to begin!

Be your favorite butterfly:
💕 Pinkfly 🧊 Icefly 🍭 Candyfly 🔥 Firefly
🌌 Galaxyfly 🌈 Rainbowfly 💀 Bonefly
💎 Diamondfly 💰 Goldfly + many more!

Take flight & go on adventures
to earn new butterflies! 
Save everything in your nest!

It's time to migrate.
Fly around & bop all the critters
to tell them it is time to go!

Land on 🐱 Caterfly or 🐹 Hamsterfly
to go on a quest.
Fly through the stars to test your
flight skills & get on the leaderboard!
Be a caterpillar or a silly human!

Lay eggs & feed your caterpillar
until it emerges as a butterfly!
Each generation pops out a new
caterpillar that keeps getting bigger!
Use different food to make
hybrid butterflies for extra points!
